title: Battery Efficiency, Background Sync & Smooth Maps
releaseNotes: Reduced battery and CPU usage by pausing animations, chat/bus/weather polls, and notifications when idle or in the background.
Restricted continuous high-accuracy GPS tracking to active turn-by-turn navigation and smoothed DC Bus map rendering.
Fixed simultaneous class reminder alerts, chat scroll-to-bottom jumps while reading history, and EXIF stripping on uploaded photos.
